author: Michal238
text:
Few weeks ago I changed the way I learn.

I've set 2 rules for myself, and I want to share it with you guys, because since I'm doing it I'm learning faster than ever.

1. I'm not trading live and demo untill I'm one with the market. I use only ForexTester.

I'm still disovering new things - there is no point to trade yet. I want
 to go live and I'm excited when I think about it but I try to use it to
 motivate myself - the faster I have market worked out completly, the
faster I can go live. My results will be fantastic. Trading will be
stress - free.

Why I'm not trading demo? Because I care about my trades. When I set
pending orders I have to watch approach & reaction and look for
reversal PA. I'm also curious what will happen. The result is that I
spent too much time looking on the same charts over and over again. I
use my platform only for analysis on setups that already happened.

But I practice trading. Only in ForexTester. It saves so much time.

Using FT2 is strictly connected with rule number 2.

2. I save all trades from FT2, all observations and all conclusions I
have while analysing charts. I make screens all the time and I read them
 on a regular basis.

Sometimes I have 10 screenshots with notes for one trade from FT2. Its very time-consuming. But it is worth it.

If I'm not sure about something (for example: can price go that far
after ENG?) I write question on a screen. I have many of those questions
 and I'm finding answer for each of this questions after analysing many
similar setups.

And here is nice setup from today

author: Michal238
text:
Hi guys.

naascott

There are few things I want to see when I'm looking for good DP:

- it can be located on swap zone

- FO zone can be created below it ( short scenario)

- also I like to see CP above strong DP - if price is compressed above,
then it is more likely that price will be reversed on this DP - it is
only fresh DP in the area

DP is a barrier to ITs, because another sellers are waiting on this
level (short scenario), so they need to do their manipulations before
price reaches it - they need to create LQ and when they do that we see
reversal patterns, FO zones etc.

bobyv87

FL and PAZ between them work in every TF, therefore some FLs are more
important than others, smaller or bigger FLs. There are diffrent
cycles.

It's quite difficult to learn spot all of this correctly but with a lot
of practice it will become clear. And don't forget to look left:

Markers are usually small FLs - ITs use them to reverse price before DP.
 I like to see when price bouces from this level few times - it creates
FO zone below DP which provides LQ for ITs. I enter on FO to DP after
confirmation - in this case it was eng into CPPAZ on approach. I thik
that after this reversal PA SL can be above DP (grey box - because it is
 FL in itself - you can see this on m1 chart). But if situation is not
very clear then you may use wider SL.
